descriptions.d10d_rgba8_rgb565_tile_801d7bb4: Convert the 4x4 block at (x, y) of a 32-bit RGBA image (bytes r, g, b, a; pitch bytes per row) into one big-endian RGB565 tile with 8-byte rows (r5 g6 b5; alpha ignored). Edge blocks are clipped (unsigned extents, at most 4) and clipped texels keep their bytes.
